mandates.title: Mandates ledger
mandates.lead: Every mandate this workspace has granted, with what it has settled, what calls in flight hold, and what is left. A mandate is the only thing that lets an agent carry a consequence, and every draw on it reserves, then settles or releases.
mandates.empty: No mandate has been granted in this workspace.
mandates.emptyDetail: A call that carries a consequence tag with no mandate is denied before dispatch, whether or not the tool is on the agent's belt.
mandates.truncated: The newest {shown} mandates. This workspace has granted at least that many, and older ones are not listed here.
mandates.emptyVisible: No mandate is listed for you. That is not the same as the workspace having granted none: you see the mandates of the agents you created, and this list is empty either way.
mandates.emptyVisibleDetail: An org Owner, Admin, Billing or Compliance reader sees every mandate this workspace has granted. This ledger is written for that office.
